rationale: The smallest plausible curriculum that made four-demo lessons identifiable was one canonical-linked slot plus dedicated top-left/bounding-box, modal-colour, and one-cell-gap slots. Fewer targeted slots left at least one executable rival compatible with some lesson windows; the four-slot schedule made 12/12 sampled lessons identifiable without weakening the oracle.
summary: Use a deterministic four-slot curriculum that alternates canonical anchors with three shortcut-killing profiles.

future_check: Keep at least one modal-colour counterexample in every generated four-demo lesson after future palette changes.
rationale: A minimal discriminator is two separated smaller components sharing one colour whose aggregate cell count exceeds the unique largest component. The authoritative rule still keeps only the single largest component. This witness fires in all three bands and the executable modal-colour rival disagrees exactly as intended.
summary: Reject the shortcut that the globally most frequent nonzero colour should survive.

future_check: If augmentation metadata gains a background-fixed palette field, migrate this task to declare nonzero-colour permutations safe while keeping arbitrary permutations forbidden.
rationale: The rule treats 0 as background and all nonzero values as object colours. D4 transformations preserve connectivity and cell counts, and a bijection over nonzero colours commutes with the rule when 0 is fixed. A schema-level Boolean cannot express this conditional legality, so the training artifact conservatively records palette_permutation_safe=false and explains the safe subset.
summary: Arbitrary palette permutation is unsafe because background 0 is semantic; nonzero-only colour permutations are safe.

future_check: Preserve both first-scan and larger-bounding-box witnesses in the semantic witness census; a zero count in any band should block intake.
rationale: The minimum discriminators place the true cell-count winner after a smaller row-major-first object and include a sparse object with a larger bounding box but fewer occupied cells. Both counterexamples are present across bands and are verified against executable rival rules.
summary: Reject row-major position and bounding-box area as substitutes for occupied-cell count.
